secrets.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
secrets.description: Signing secret for Better Auth sessions. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

secrets.name: XAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: xAI API key for Bud AI responses. Without it, Bud shows a 'not connected' message (fail-closed). Get from https://console.x.ai

secrets.name: GROK_AUTH_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: OAuth client ID for the Grok auth broker federated sign-in. Without it, falls back to the shared preview client.

secrets.name: GROK_AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: OAuth client secret for the Grok auth broker. Without it, falls back to the shared preview client.
